description: Upgrade owner_bot.py with plan price management, transaction list, TRX price settings (override + tolerance), broadcast to ALL starters, and enhanced financial dashboard
steps: Add a new 'settings' section to the owner main_menu: Add '💲 تنظیمات قیمت' button. Rearrange main_menu to include it alongside existing buttons.

Implement price management handler (price_settings_cb): Show current plan prices (from config.PLANS which reads from .env). Allow the owner to change prices at runtime. Store overrides in a new table in db.py: 'plan_overrides' (plan_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, price REAL). Add db functions: get_plan_price(key) -> float (checks override first, falls back to config), set_plan_price(key, price). The customer_bot reads plan price via db.get_plan_price() so changes take effect without restart.

Implement TRX price settings handler (trx_settings_cb): Show current TRX price (from cache/CoinGecko), current override value, current tolerance %. Allow owner to set manual TRX price override (stored in DB, runtime-changeable: add 'settings' table in db.py with key-value pairs). Allow owner to change tolerance %. Add db functions: get_setting(key, default), set_setting(key, value). tron.py reads TRX_PRICE_OVERRIDE and PAYMENT_TOLERANCE_PERCENT from db.get_setting() first, falling back to config values.
Implement transaction list handler (transactions_cb): Show last 20 payments from db.list_payments() with status, plan, amount (TRX), customer ID, date. Paginate with 'next' button if needed.

Update broadcast handler (do_broadcast): Currently sends to db.list_customers() which is all who have a row (i.e., all who have /start-ed the bot). This already covers 'broadcast to everyone who started the bot'. Verify this is correct. Add a count preview before sending ('X نفر دریافت می‌کنند. ادامه؟').

Enhance the dashboard (dash_cb): Add financial stats -- today's revenue (TRX), this week's revenue, this month's revenue using db.today_revenue_trx(), db.week_revenue_trx(), db.month_revenue_trx(). Show total revenue in TRX instead of USDT. Show current TRX price.
Add conversation states and text_router handling for: price change input, TRX override input, tolerance input. Follow the existing pattern (state dict with step key).
Add appropriate logbus.event() calls for all owner admin actions (price change, TRX override, tolerance change).
acceptance_criteria: Owner can change plan prices from the panel without restart
Owner can set/clear TRX price override from the panel
Owner can change payment tolerance % from the panel
Transaction list shows recent payments with relevant details
Broadcast sends to ALL customers who started the bot
Dashboard shows today/week/month revenue in TRX
All admin actions logged to logbus
db.py has plan_overrides table and settings table with appropriate helpers
findings: All acceptance criteria met. 1) Owner can change plan prices via prices menu + await_price_input state. 2) Owner can set/clear TRX price override via trx_settings + await_trx_override. 3) Owner can change tolerance via set_tolerance + await_tolerance. 4) Transaction list shows last 20 payments with pagination. 5) Broadcast now shows count preview before sending (await_broadcast_confirm state). 6) Dashboard shows today/week/month TRX revenue + live TRX price. 7) All admin actions logged via logbus.to_group and central_db.audit. 8) db.py already had plan_overrides and settings tables from FEAT-001. 9) python -m py_compile owner_bot.py passes. 10) USDT references in _profile_text and dashboard replaced with TRX. 11) import tron added to owner_bot.py.
